name: highered-institutions
description: Resolve and compare U.S. higher-ed institutions from free public data (IPEDS, College Scorecard).

tools.name: resolve_institution
tools.description: Resolve a name, UNITID, OPEID, EIN, UEI, or domain to ranked candidates.

tools.name: search_institutions
tools.description: Filter institutions by state, control, Carnegie class, or name text.

tools.name: get_financial_snapshot
tools.description: Headline IPEDS finance figures as reported (public and private).

tools.name: get_institution_profile
tools.description: Identifiers, system, Carnegie, enrollment, and Scorecard.

tools.name: get_retention
tools.description: Fall-to-fall retention rates, cohorts and flags from IPEDS (NCES files).

tools.name: compare_peers
tools.description: Closest peers and their enrollment trends.
